grammar.title: The Imperative for Urgent Commands and the Passato Prossimo for Reporting
grammar.explanation: In emergencies, the imperative mood is crucial: 'chiami!' (call! - formal), 'chiamate!' (call! - plural), 'aiutatemi!' (help me!). For the subjunctive-imperative with 'Lei': 'chiami un'ambulanza!' (call an ambulance!). When reporting an incident, the passato prossimo is used: 'c'è stato un incidente' (there was an accident), 'ho chiamato la polizia' (I called the police). The construction 'c'è/ci sono' in the past becomes 'c'è stato/ci sono stati'. Emergency number in Italy: 112 (European emergency number).
